title: Person Re-ID in 2025: Supervised, Self-Supervised, and Language-Aligned—What Works?
reasoning: The paper is a technical comparative study and benchmark of Person Re-Identification (ReID) models. It focuses on evaluating the robustness and generalization of different training paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, and language-aligned) across various surveillance and in-the-wild datasets. It does not contain any evaluation or discussion related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
